description: This file defines the ImpactProjectItemTransformer class in the Goteo project, responsible for transforming impact project items into various representations, including retrieving impact data and generating action URLs related to impact items within a project.

classes.name: ImpactProjectItemTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class for impact project items, providing methods to retrieve impact IDs, names, values, and generate project-related URLs.

methods.name: getImpactProjectId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the impact project.

methods.name: getImpactDataId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the impact data item.

methods.name: getImpactItemName
methods.description: Returns the name of the impact item.

methods.name: getImpactValue
methods.description: Returns the impact value concatenated with its unit.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Generates URLs for editing, viewing costs, and deleting the impact item related to a project.
